title: Analog Clock has no independent time zone
line: The Analog Clock now has a Time Zone settings page, so each clock can show a different place's time.
explanation: The Analog Clock's Clock object never had its timeZone set and the widget had no setting for one, so every Analog Clock always followed the system time zone. The Digital Clock already supported other time zones through its own config and the shared time zone map. The change adds a timeZone config entry (default "Local" = system time zone), binds the clock to it, and adds a "Time Zone" config page with "Use systemwide time zone" / "Use a different time zone:" and the shared TimezoneSelector map below.

commits.message:
applets/analogclock: allow choosing a time zone

Unlike the Digital Clock, the Analog Clock always showed the system time
zone, so two of them could not show different places. Add a Time Zone
config page with the time zone map, and use the chosen zone for the clock.

BUG: 372468

From e97e0b74c73f3cfe479df09d41606169f9009c3b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 22:29:08 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/analogclock: allow choosing a time zone

Unlike the Digital Clock, the Analog Clock always showed the system time
zone, so two of them could not show different places. Add a Time Zone
config page with the time zone map, and use the chosen zone for the clock.

BUG: 372468

 applets/analog-clock/main.xml               |  4 ++

diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/CMakeLists.txt b/applets/analog-clock/CMakeLists.txt
index daf54edbf7..641472ee3f 100644
--- a/applets/analog-clock/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@ plasma_add_applet(org.kde.plasma.analogclock
         qml/main.qml
         qml/Hand.qml
         qml/configGeneral.qml
+        qml/configTimeZone.qml
         qml/config.qml
     RESOURCES
         main.xml
diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/main.xml b/applets/analog-clock/main.xml
index 07be98ee39..9f3bfa585a 100644
--- a/applets/analog-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/main.xml
@@ -12,6 +12,10 @@
     <entry name="showTimezoneString" type="Bool">
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="timeZone" type="String">
+      <label>The time zone shown by the clock. Format is "Europe/London". Special entry "Local" indicates system time zone.</label>
+      <default>Local</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/qml/config.qml b/applets/analog-clock/qml/config.qml
index 6c73045649..f10b70b91b 100644
--- a/applets/analog-clock/qml/config.qml
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/qml/config.qml
@@ -14,4 +14,9 @@ ConfigModel {
          icon: "preferences-desktop-color"
          source: "configGeneral.qml"
     }
+    ConfigCategory {
+         name: i18n("Time Zone")
+         icon: "preferences-system-time"
+         source: "configTimeZone.qml"
+    }
 }
diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/qml/configTimeZone.qml b/applets/analog-clock/qml/configTimeZone.qml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..45fbe587a7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/qml/configTimeZone.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
+
+import org.kde.plasma.clock
+import org.kde.plasma.workspace.timezoneselector as TimeZone
+
+KCM.AbstractKCM {
+    id: root
+
+    property string cfg_timeZone
+
+    readonly property bool useSystemTimeZone: cfg_timeZone === "Local" || cfg_timeZone === ""
+
+    Clock {
+        id: systemClock
+    }
+
+    ColumnLayout {
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            text: i18nc("@option:radio", "Use systemwide time zone")
+            checked: root.useSystemTimeZone
+            onToggled: root.cfg_timeZone = "Local"
+        }
+
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            text: i18nc("@option:radio", "Use a different time zone:")
+            checked: !root.useSystemTimeZone
+            onToggled: root.cfg_timeZone = timeZoneSelector.selectedTimeZone
+        }
+
+        TimeZone.TimezoneSelector {
+            id: timeZoneSelector
+
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            Layout.fillHeight: true
+            Layout.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+
+            enabled: !root.useSystemTimeZone
+
+            Component.onCompleted: selectedTimeZone = root.useSystemTimeZone ? systemClock.timeZone : root.cfg_timeZone
+
+            onSelectedTimeZoneChanged: {
+                if (!root.useSystemTimeZone && selectedTimeZone) {
+                    root.cfg_timeZone = selectedTimeZone;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml b/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
index 9e0092d478..d48f27c6cc 100644
--- a/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
@@ -45,6 +45,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     Clock {
         id: clockSource
+        timeZone: Plasmoid.configuration.timeZone
         trackSeconds: analogclock.showSecondsHand || (analogclock.compactRepresentationItem as MouseArea).containsMouse
     }
 
--

media.caption: Analog Clock settings on master: only Appearance (seconds hand, show time zone); no way to choose a time zone
With the fix: new Time Zone page, defaulting to the systemwide time zone, with the time zone map to pick another
Two Analog Clocks on master: both can only show local time (10:26)
With the fix: one clock set to America/New_York (4:28), the other on the system zone Europe/Rome (10:28), time zone labels on
